sql: SELECT fire_year, COUNT(*) AS fire_count, SUM(COALESCE(final_acres, gis_acres)) AS total_acres, MIN(discovery_date) AS min_date, MAX(discovery_date) AS max_date FROM disasters.wildfire_perimeters WHERE fire_year BETWEEN 2015 AND 2026 GROUP BY fire_year ORDER BY fire_year
SELECT MAX(fire_year) AS max_year, MIN(fire_year) AS min_year, COUNT(*) AS total_rows FROM disasters.wildfire_perimeters
SELECT fire_year, COUNT(*) FROM disasters.wildfire_perimeters WHERE fire_year >= 2023 GROUP BY fire_year ORDER BY fire_year

SELECT event_type, "year", COUNT(*) AS event_count, SUM(deaths_direct+deaths_indirect) AS deaths FROM disasters.storm_events WHERE event_type ILIKE '%wildfire%' AND "year" >= 2020 GROUP BY event_type, "year" ORDER BY "year"
